title: 1 一技之长2 打探3 外练筋骨皮
content_zh:
秋高气爽，风和日丽。
江云州地处大魏南部，气候温暖，比其他州暖和些。
即便是快要入冬，路上的行人还有很多穿着短袖短裤。
下午。
松宜城中行人来来往往。
百味街是松宜城中最为繁华的街区之一。
这里汇集了大魏各大州的美食，号称世间百种滋味都能尝到。
因此被称为百味街。
“好！”
“精彩！”
碧丹茶楼中爆发出热烈的喝彩声。
说书台上，少年先生娓娓道来。
“夜色深沉，万籁俱寂。
宁采臣刚要睡着，就感觉有人进了他的屋子。
他赶忙坐了起来，一看来人，竟是刚刚北院那户人家的漂亮的姑娘，他依稀记得这姑娘名叫小倩。
宁采臣惊讶道，‘姑娘怎么到小生房里来了？’
小倩娇媚一笑……”
“……”
啪！
醒目一拍，先生结束了今天的内容：“欲知后事如何，且听下回分解！”

“啊！”
“这就没了？”
“不是吧，刚到精彩之处！”
“小先生，再来一段呗，现在时间还早！”
茶楼中，客人们纷纷出声表示没听够。
说书台后，是一名十六七岁的少年书生。
少年脸型五官不错，只是有些黝黑，稍显瘦弱。
他一袭青衫，书生打扮，身上透着股书生意气。
“不了不了，再说下去喉咙撑不住。”
林哲羽摆了摆手说道。
他的声音有些沙哑，讲了一个多时辰，喉咙有些撑不住。
“这可怎么办，我今晚要睡不着了。”
“小先生太可恶，竟然在这里停了。”
……
在客人们不舍的呼声中，少年拱了拱手走下台。
“小先生大才，竟然能够写出这般香艳故事，连我这个年岁的人，听了都不禁向往。”
content_en:
The autumn air is crisp and the wind is gentle and the sun is beautiful.
Jiangyun Prefecture is located in the southern part of the Wei Dynasty and has a warm climate, which is warmer than other prefectures.
Even though winter is approaching, many pedestrians on the road are still wearing short-sleeves and shorts.
afternoon.
Pedestrians come and go in Songyi City.
Baiwei Street is one of the most prosperous neighborhoods in Songyi City.
This place brings together delicacies from all the major states in the Wei Dynasty, and it is said that you can taste hundreds of flavors in the world.
Therefore it is called Baiwei Street.
"Okay!"
“Wonderful!”
The Bidan Tea House burst into enthusiastic cheers.
On the storytelling table, the young gentleman spoke eloquently.
“The night is deep and everything is silent.
Just as Ning Caichen was about to fall asleep, he felt someone entering his house.
He hurriedly sat up, and when he saw the person, she turned out to be a beautiful girl from the family in the North Courtyard just now. He vaguely remembered that the girl's name was Xiaoqian.
Ning Caichen was surprised and asked, "Why did the girl come to the niche?" ’
Xiaoqian smiled charmingly..."
"..."
Snap!
With a striking snap, the husband ended today's content: "If you want to know what happened next time, let's listen to the breakdown next time!"
"Ah!"
"Is this gone?"
"No, we just got to the exciting part!"
"Little sir, let's do it again, it's still early!"
In the teahouse, the guests expressed their displeasure that they had not heard enough.
Behind the storytelling desk is a young scholar of sixteen or seventeen years old.
The young man's face has good facial features, but he is a little dark and a little thin.
He was dressed like a scholar in a green shirt, and he exuded the spirit of a scholar.
"No, no, no, my throat won't hold up if I keep talking."
Lin Zheyu waved his hand and said.
His voice was a little hoarse, and after speaking for more than an hour, his throat felt a little weak.
"What can I do? I won't be able to sleep tonight."
"Young man, it's so disgusting that you stopped here."
…
Amid the reluctant cries of the guests, the young man bowed his hands and walked off the stage.
"A young gentleman with a great talent can actually write such a charming story. Even people my age can't help but yearn for it after hearing it."
